start: ^Thirty-eight years I waited at the pool. Thirty-eight years.
^Then a man came and asked me if I wanted to be healed.
^Pick up your mat and walk. I did.
^Sky. Balance. These are the things you forget they are things until they return.

s: ^What did the Jerusalem elders do next?
^What did he tell you to do, once you walked?
^What did the Jerusalem elders do next?
^What did he tell you to do, once you walked?
